required_outcomes: Confirms to Tom that his notice was received on 2 October and acknowledged, with the end date of 5 December 2026.
Gives him the key facts already set up: checkout on Saturday 5 December at 10:00, keys to the clerk, deposit returned via mydeposits after checkout.
Does nothing new beyond the reply: no new notice workflow, no new landlord request, no escalation.
acceptable_alternatives: Suggesting he check his spam folder for the two earlier emails, or offering to resend them.
positive_behaviours: Keeps the reply short and reassuring.
red_flags: Asking Ben again to accept or approve the notice.
Treating the message as a new notice and recalculating the end date from today.
prohibited_actions: Booking a second checkout or changing the agreed end date.
critical_failures: Telling Tom his notice was not received or must be given again, contrary to the activity log.
